description: This file contains unit tests for the deep linking security features in the OpenClawKit application, specifically testing the validation logic of URLs and setup codes related to gateway connections.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying security constraints related to deep links and setup codes in the OpenClawKit app.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway URL with a non-loopback insecure websocket is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a gateway URL attempting to bypass host restrictions with a special prefix is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway URL with a loopback address and secure websocket is accepted.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with a non-loopback websocket URL is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with a bypass host is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with a loopback address in websocket URL is accepted.
